_comment: SYNTHETIC. The fictional NVIDIA / Veltrani Photonics acquisition from the bounded end-to-end run e2e-20260929-842a7f.
Veltrani Photonics, the publishers and every URL are fictional; no such transaction exists.
articles a-d, the judgments for b-d and summaries v1/v2 are copied from that run's stored records (article text,
comparison labels, differences and verbatim evidence quotes; published summary statements and their quotes).
Article e, its judgment and summary v3_confirmed are additional fictional test material for multi-dispute and
post-review cases. offset_minutes is relative to each test's own time window.

a.headline: NVIDIA signs agreement to acquire Veltrani Photonics for USD 250 million
paragraphs: NVIDIA Corporation has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Veltrani Photonics, a privately held developer of optical interconnect components for data center networks, for USD 250 million in cash.

The companies said the transaction is expected to close in December 2026, subject to regulatory approval. The acquisition has not yet closed. Until closing, Veltrani Photonics will continue to operate as an independent company.

b.headline: Veltrani Photonics to be bought by NVIDIA in USD 250 million cash deal
paragraphs: Veltrani Photonics, a private company that makes optical interconnect parts used in data center networks, has agreed to be acquired by NVIDIA. Under the definitive agreement the two companies signed, NVIDIA will pay USD 250 million in cash.
The deal still requires regulatory approval and has not been completed. The companies expect it to close in December 2026, and Veltrani Photonics will keep operating independently until then.

c.headline: NVIDIA's Veltrani Photonics acquisition receives regulatory approval
paragraphs: NVIDIA's planned acquisition of Veltrani Photonics, the privately held optical interconnect developer, has received regulatory approval, the companies said.
The approval satisfies the regulatory condition in the definitive agreement. The purchase price is unchanged at USD 250 million in cash.
The acquisition has not closed yet. NVIDIA and Veltrani Photonics said they still expect the transaction to close in December 2026.

d.headline: NVIDIA's signed agreement for Veltrani Photonics set the price at USD 300 million, not USD 250 million
paragraphs: The definitive agreement NVIDIA signed to acquire Veltrani Photonics, the privately held optical interconnect developer, specified cash consideration of USD 300 million, according to people familiar with the signed agreement.

That figure refers to the same original agreement and the same all-cash purchase price that other outlets reported as USD 250 million. Fixture Finance Journal is not reporting an amended, revised or additional payment: its sources said USD 300 million was the price in the agreement as originally signed.
The transaction is expected to close in December 2026.

e.headline: Veltrani Photonics agreement sets March 2027 closing date, not December 2026
paragraphs: The definitive agreement NVIDIA signed to acquire Veltrani Photonics sets an expected closing date of March 2027, according to a copy reviewed by Example Business Review.
Other outlets reported that the companies expect the transaction to close in December 2026. Example Business Review said the March 2027 date appears in the agreement as originally signed.
